$comment: Transcribed from mcp__Wix__SearchWixAPISpec on 2026-09-30 for wix.social.groups.api.v2.Group (List Groups, https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/crm/community/groups/groups/list-groups). Used by gatorbot.mjs to validate post targets.
feedCreateEndpoint: NOT FOUND in the public REST spec on 2026-09-30 (three ranked SearchWixRESTDocumentation queries and a lightIndex scan for feed|social-groups|posts returned only Comments/Moderation resources). Group feed posts are created in the Groups app UI, or by Velo, or by the Comments API for replies; GatorBot therefore emits a handoff payload for the feed post and a fully validated API payload for rules.
